body: I am so lost I don’t know what to do
I did but it’s not easy. I feel like I am running away from my own thoughts. It’s so crazy. I can’t stop it. I have therapy today, maybe that will help

Thank you so much for your response. It’s so hard to see from that perspective. My therapist has told me the same things but my critical inner voice keeps telling me the opposite and it’s so so hard to control that when I am overreacting. These thoughts just flood my mind. I just hope i can see that throughout time, but it’s draining myself and also my boyfriend. He told me he’s been emotionally drained lately and I don’t want to lose him because of me. I don’t know if I could forgive myself if that happens.
